subject: Data border-controls questionnaire & private deployment runbook
messages:
From: Lara Benton <compliance@healthlogix.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@healthlogix.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Data border controls questionnaire & prep for private deployment

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing HealthLogix's vendor pack for an upcoming audit and we need Redwood's responses and evidence for the items below so we can close our SIG/CAIQ and SOC2 references:

1) CAIQ mapping: a short spreadsheet mapping CAIQ questions to Redwood Private controls (network, KMS, logging, change control).
2) High‑level network topology for EU Private deployment including peering (diagram preferred).
3) KMS key partitioning — do keys live per region, per-tenant, or both? Key rotation & key backup policy.
4) Evidence that runtime KV cache/prefix cache and request logs do not leave the EU region for EU‑only tenants.
5) Confirm whether model weights or replicas are ever replicated to non‑EU zones (and under what circumstances).
6) A sample private‑connect runbook for onboarding (steps, required customer firewall egress/ingress, estimated lead time).
7) Redacted SOC2 (if available) and SOC2 scoping statement for Redwood Private.
8) Current list of egress IP ranges and peering endpoints for EU hosting.

Can you send a first packet by end of day Monday (Sep 6)? If anything needs longer, please call out the items and estimated delivery. Also flag anything that is proprietary and needs an NDA or restricted handling.

Thanks — we can schedule a short walkthrough once we have the initial packet.

—Lara Benton
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
HealthLogix

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Benton <compliance@healthlogix.com>
Cc: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@healthlogix.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data border controls questionnaire & prep for private deployment

Lara — thanks for the clear list. We'll take this as an action and break it into deliverables. High level plan below; see attachments and Drive link for drafts.

Deliverables we will provide by EOD Mon (Sep 6):
- CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (attached: redwood_caiq_mapping_draft.xlsx)
- EU private network topology (attached PNG; labelled network-diagram-v1.png)
- Initial runbook sample (attached: private-connect-runbook-sample.md)
- Redacted SOC2 report (attached: soc2-redacted.pdf)
- Preliminary egress IP ranges (included in CAIQ spreadsheet)

Open items that may need an extended timeline:
- KMS partitioning: we can confirm architecture now and provide policy excerpts by Sep 6; per-tenant customer-managed keys (BYOK) for EU PHI customers require a short integration (estimated 10 working days to enable and validate).
- Runtime cache residency proof: we will provide the architectural control statement and an ops runbook for validation by Sep 6; for full operational evidence (traces showing no cross-region writes) we will need an ops window to pull logs (we propose Sep 14–16).

Short answers to your numbered list:
1) Attached spreadsheet maps CAIQ rows to Redwood control IDs.
2) See network-diagram-v1.png — shows private peering, transit, and NAT/egress points inside the EU region.
3) KMS: by default keys are regionally scoped; we support per-tenant keys via KMS key policies or customer‑managed keys (BYOK). More detail in the attached mapping.
4) Cache/log residency: application KV prefix cache is stored on ephemeral regional GPU hosts and is not persisted to cross-region object stores; request logs are retained within the tenant's region for EU‑only deployments.
5) Model weights: model artifacts are primarily stored in regional object stores; cross-region replication is only performed for disaster recovery and with customer permission in the engagement; we will flag where replication is enabled.
6) Runbook attached; rough lead time for Private Connect activation: 2–3 weeks after network approvals (dependent on customer firewall changes & peering approvals).
7) SOC2 redacted attached.
8) Egress IPs: initial ranges included in the CAIQ spreadsheet; final list will be published to the shared Drive when peering is scheduled.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E6f7G8h (read‑only link to packet drafts)
HubSpot ticket: HS-48392 (we'll keep updates there).

Markus and Grace are on point for the runbook and network diagram; I'll coordinate the KMS team. If HealthLogix requires per-tenant BYOK with a contractual KMS separation clause, let us know and we'll include it in the SOW (estimated 10 business days to enable and validate).

If you want a quick sync, I can offer 30 minutes on Mon Sep 6 14:00–16:00 CEST or Tue Sep 7 09:00–11:00 CEST; propose a time and we'll send an invite.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_draft.xlsx, network-diagram-v1.png, private-connect-runbook-sample.md, soc2-redacted.pdf

From: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@healthlogix.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Benton <compliance@healthlogix.com>, HealthLogix Security Team <security@healthlogix.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Data border controls questionnaire & prep for private deployment

Naomi — appreciate the quick turn. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- For PHI scopes we require cryptographic separation: is Redwood able to provide per-tenant KMS keys where the customer holds the root key (BYOK) for EU-only tenants? We need confirmation that key material never transits outside EU control plane during import.
- Do you offer rack-level tenancy (single-tenant blades) for customers who require physical separation? If yes, what's the lead time and pricing band?
- For the model weights question: if replication is enabled for DR, can HealthLogix require replication only to another EU AZ (no cross-border replicas)?

Also we need the signed BAA / DPA next week — can you route us to the right person for DocuSign?

Would prefer to take the sync on Tue Sep 7 09:00 CEST.

Thanks,
Mike Lewis
Head of Product Operations
HealthLogix

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@healthlogix.com>, Lara Benton <compliance@healthlogix.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data border controls questionnaire & prep for private deployment

Mike / Lara — quick answers and next steps.

1) BYOK & KMS import: yes — we support customer‑managed keys. Key imports are performed via a regional KMS import tool; import operations are audited and do not transfer key material outside the import region. We will attach the KMS import procedure excerpt to the packet (attached as part of the CAIQ mapping in Drive). Full technical onboarding for BYOK is a 10 business day engagement (dev+ops verification).

2) Rack/single-tenant options: we do offer isolated GPU blade pools for customers requiring physical separation. Lead time is typically 6–8 weeks for capacity allocation; pricing and SLAs are scoped in a Dedicated contract (we'll have our sales rep follow up if you want a formal quote).

3) Replication controls: model artifact replication can be constrained to EU AZs only. We will include a configuration checkbox in the SOW and provide an auditable configuration file for your records.

4) BAA / DPA: for signatures, please use this DocuSign envelope link (we'll route to legal): https://docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-HEALTHLOGIX‑BAA (I'll copy our legal so it moves quickly).

Next steps & timeline:
- Sep 6 (EOD) — complete CAIQ draft, network diagram, runbook sample, SOC2 redaction (in Drive).
- Sep 14–16 — ops validation window for residency traces if you require live evidence. We'll need a signed confidentiality addendum for full log extracts.
- Sep 20–24 — target private connect prep & peering (dependent on your firewall changes).

I attached the packet drafts to this reply and confirmed links in HubSpot: HS-48392. Markus — please prepare the KMS import excerpt and the per-tenant key policy snippets. Grace — please prepare an itemized pricing note for rack-level tenancy and a short SLA summary.

I'll schedule the Tue Sep 7 09:00 CEST sync and send an invite.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_draft.xlsx, network-diagram-v1.png, private-connect-runbook-sample.md, soc2-redacted.pdf
